entity: Las Vegas Sands, Texas lobby/ad media spending 2021-26
what_we_add: $20.58M filed as lobby 'media' spending under one lobbyist (Abboud) across 62 monthly reports; 2.5x all other Texas lobbyists combined (70-71% share); about 4x Sands' ~$5.1M federal lobby fees in the same months
why: Texas Tribune (2021) and Texas Standard (2025) name Sands and report a multimillion-dollar, nonstop Texas TV/radio ad campaign: same finding in words, same direction. No source has the lobby-report total, the share of all Texas lobby media or the federal comparison; the Tribune's company-pegged 'at least $2M' covers only the 2021 session, so it can't contradict a 2021-26 total.
